source.paper: Hindustan Times, HT Classifieds on Sunday (Gurgaon property)

summary: A Sunday real-estate classifieds page that is almost all colour display: htclassifieds logo in heavy lowercase, a yellow ON SUNDAY tab, then a tight mosaic of developer ads and small boxed property listings with red, yellow and blue reverse heads and plot numbers set huge in grids.

frame.masthead: Small 'hindustantimes' over a huge heavy lowercase 'htclassifieds' (black + orange), yellow ON SUNDAY block, thin booking-phone strip.

headers.notes: Locality names as reverse bars in red, blue or black.

units.notes: Available plot numbers in big bold cells: a numeric grid as the ad.
Yellow, red or blue fills, condensed heavy heads, phone in reverse at the foot.

units.example: RAHEJA 2/3 BHK Available / Price ₹3075/- sq. ft.

notes: Image is small; most liners are unreadable. The plot-number grid is a distinctive unit.
